title: Anthropic Files IPO, Sanders Demands Public AI Equity, Banks Cut 7K Jobs To AI
pattern: The infrastructure layer of AI is consolidating into monopoly-scale valuations (Anthropic's $965B IPO filing) while the labor layer is being dismantled in real time (7,000 Standard Chartered job cuts). The gap between capital concentration and worker displacement is widening faster than policy can respond. Sanders' sovereign wealth fund proposal is the first serious attempt to build a dam.

stories.title: Anthropic Confidentially Files To Go Public
stories.summary: Anthropic moving toward public markets would mark another step in AI becoming a capital-market story, not just a research story. The company building the tools becomes an asset class, and everyone else has to ask what kind of future that capital is buying.
keyPoints: The AI infrastructure layer is attracting public-market scale expectations.
A potential IPO would further formalize AI as one of the central economic bets of this era.
TGR relevance: workers and creators need to understand where value is accumulating, not only where disruption is landing.

stories.title: Bernie Sanders AI Bill Would Give Public Half Of The AI Industry
stories.summary: Sanders' proposal is a blunt response to the central AI economy question: if the tools are trained on public knowledge and displace public labor, should the upside remain private? Whether or not the policy survives, the frame matters.
keyPoints: The story pushes AI ownership from business model debate into public policy.
It names the gap between private AI wealth and public exposure to displacement.
This is Reclaim Value at societal scale: who owns the value created from shared human output?

stories.title: Standard Chartered To Cut More Than 7,000 Jobs As It Steps Up AI Use
stories.summary: Banking is where the AI labor story becomes painfully concrete. When a major institution links efficiency and job cuts, the old promise of gradual reskilling starts to feel thin.
keyPoints: AI is being tied to large-scale workforce reduction in a major bank.
Knowledge-work disruption is moving through regulated, white-collar industries, not only tech companies.
For TGR, this is the moment to unhook identity before the institution does it for you.

stories.title: AI LLM Agent Cyberattack Exfiltrates AWS Database
stories.summary: Agentic AI raises the stakes because the system is no longer only generating text. It can act. When those actions touch real infrastructure, security becomes part of AI literacy.
keyPoints: The story points to AI agents as operational actors, not passive tools.
Security risks grow when models can plan, access systems, and execute steps.
This is Discover AI's Power in its least cozy form: capability always includes consequence.

stories.title: AI Isn't Replacing Creativity. It's Moving It Upstream.
stories.summary: The creative shift is not that AI makes imagination irrelevant. It is that more of the human work moves into framing, taste, direction, and judgment before execution begins.
keyPoints: AI changes where creative value sits in the process.
The durable human layer becomes taste, intent, editing, and meaning-making.
This is Start Creating after Reclaim Value: use the tools to amplify the part only you can bring.
